name: Acute Senses
description: Double the range and acuity of your senses. Apply your Wyrd as bonus dice to perception rolls and rolls to identify or recall details.
descriptionEn: Double the range and acuity of your senses. Apply your Wyrd as bonus dice to perception rolls and rolls to identify or recall details.

name: Arcadian Metabolism
description: Heal bashing damage each minute of rest and lethal damage daily in the Hedge.
descriptionEn: Heal bashing damage each minute of rest and lethal damage daily in the Hedge.

name: Brownie's Boon
description: Extended actions outside the sight of witnesses occur at twice the speed (half intervals), or spend Glamour for four times the speed.
descriptionEn: Extended actions outside the sight of witnesses occur at twice the speed (half intervals), or spend Glamour for four times the speed.

name: Cloak of Leaves
description: Apply dots of this Merit as a penalty to supernatural abilities used to physically harm you.
descriptionEn: Apply dots of this Merit as a penalty to supernatural abilities used to physically harm you.

name: Cold Hearted
description: Spend Willpower to ignore the effects of a Clarity Condition briefly.
descriptionEn: Spend Willpower to ignore the effects of a Clarity Condition briefly.

name: Court Goodwill
description: You have the good favor of another Court's courtiers and patron. Functions like the Allies Merit at equal rating, the Court Mantle at two dots lower, and as a one-dot Mentor.
descriptionEn: You have the good favor of another Court's courtiers and patron. Functions like the Allies Merit at equal rating, the Court Mantle at two dots lower, and as a one-dot Mentor.

name: Defensive Dreamscaping
description: Add half Wyrd, rounded down, to your Defense in Dream Form.
descriptionEn: Add half Wyrd, rounded down, to your Defense in Dream Form.

name: Diviner
description: Once per session for each dot in this Merit, comb your dreams for answers and ask the Storyteller a yes or no question.
descriptionEn: Once per session for each dot in this Merit, comb your dreams for answers and ask the Storyteller a yes or no question.

name: Dream Warrior
prerequisites: Wyrd ••, any Social Attribute •••, Brawl or Weaponry Specialty
description: When you allocate successes from one of the named Skills in which you have a Specialty to perform subtle oneiromantic shifts in aid of combat, add a bonus success.
descriptionEn: When you allocate successes from one of the named Skills in which you have a Specialty to perform subtle oneiromantic shifts in aid of combat, add a bonus success.

name: Dreamweaver
description: Once a scene, spend Willpower to achieve a dreamweaving exceptional success on a threshold of three instead of five.
descriptionEn: Once a scene, spend Willpower to achieve a dreamweaving exceptional success on a threshold of three instead of five.

name: Dull Beacon
description: When you drop the Mask, open the Hedge as if your Wyrd were reduced by dots in this Merit, to a minimum of 0.
descriptionEn: When you drop the Mask, open the Hedge as if your Wyrd were reduced by dots in this Merit, to a minimum of 0.

name: Fae Mount
description: You've befriended and trained a loyal Hedge denizen and can call it at will there. Each dot in this Merit gives your mount one of a set of gifts, such as natural armor or the ability to exit the Hedge under a Mask.
descriptionEn: You've befriended and trained a loyal Hedge denizen and can call it at will there. Each dot in this Merit gives your mount one of a set of gifts, such as natural armor or the ability to exit the Hedge under a Mask.

name: Faerie Favor
description: You possess an owed favor from one of the Gentry in the form of a bauble, though cashing it in will render Notoriety for your questionable dealing.
descriptionEn: You possess an owed favor from one of the Gentry in the form of a bauble, though cashing it in will render Notoriety for your questionable dealing.

name: Fair Harvest
description: You favor one emotional flavor of Glamour over others. Take 8-Again, or with two dots the rote quality, to harvest it, but lose 10-Again, and with two dots subtract a success, to harvest others.
descriptionEn: You favor one emotional flavor of Glamour over others. Take 8-Again, or with two dots the rote quality, to harvest it, but lose 10-Again, and with two dots subtract a success, to harvest others.

name: Firebrand
description: Once a scene, recover Willpower by inciting a fight.
descriptionEn: Once a scene, recover Willpower by inciting a fight.

name: Frightful Incantation
prerequisites: Hedge Sorcerer, Mantle •• that imposes fear-based Bedlam conditions, Resolve ••
description: Can use Mantle and Mein in place of a hecatomb, opening Doors up to Mantle rating each story.
descriptionEn: Can use Mantle and Mein in place of a hecatomb, opening Doors up to Mantle rating each story.

name: Gentrified Bearing
description: Hobs are cautious that you might be Gentry. Add your Wyrd as an Intimidation bonus.
descriptionEn: Hobs are cautious that you might be Gentry. Add your Wyrd as an Intimidation bonus.

name: Glamour Fasting
description: Glamour deprivation doesn't set in for one full session unless you exhaust your Willpower.
descriptionEn: Glamour deprivation doesn't set in for one full session unless you exhaust your Willpower.

name: Goblin Bounty
description: Each session you have access to three common goblin fruits or oddments for each dot in this Merit.
descriptionEn: Each session you have access to three common goblin fruits or oddments for each dot in this Merit.

name: Grounded
description: Apply a point of Armor against mild Clarity damage.
descriptionEn: Apply a point of Armor against mild Clarity damage.

name: Hedge Brawler
description: Take up to a -3 attack penalty to gain, on success, an equal number of Hedgespinning successes.
descriptionEn: Take up to a -3 attack penalty to gain, on success, an equal number of Hedgespinning successes.

name: Hedge Sense
description: +2 to navigate or search the Hedge.
descriptionEn: +2 to navigate or search the Hedge.

name: Hedge Sorcerer
description: You can perform Hedge Sorcery rituals.
descriptionEn: You can perform Hedge Sorcery rituals.

name: Hedgewise
description: +2 to ken even magically concealed Hedgeways, and 9-Again to Hedgespinning.
descriptionEn: +2 to ken even magically concealed Hedgeways, and 9-Again to Hedgespinning.

name: Hob Kin
description: You benefit from a better impression from hobs you meet.
descriptionEn: You benefit from a better impression from hobs you meet.

name: Lethal Mien
description: You can deal lethal damage unarmed, or if you already have natural weapons, increase their weapon rating by +1.
descriptionEn: You can deal lethal damage unarmed, or if you already have natural weapons, increase their weapon rating by +1.

name: Librarian
description: Your impression level is one higher at the first social interaction with librarians and scholars, you keep or lose the bonus depending on your behaviour on subsequent encounters. Gain two additional dice on rolls about researching written accounts.
descriptionEn: Your impression level is one higher at the first social interaction with librarians and scholars, you keep or lose the bonus depending on your behaviour on subsequent encounters. Gain two additional dice on rolls about researching written accounts.

name: Magic Dreams
description: May use Hedge Sorcery in dreams, substituting oneiromancy for Hedgespinning.
descriptionEn: May use Hedge Sorcery in dreams, substituting oneiromancy for Hedgespinning.

name: Mantle
description: Your mien is attuned to a local Court. Apply Mantle as a Social bonus among friends of the Court. Gain a source of Glamour, Mantle benefits, and Contract access as per your Court.
descriptionEn: Your mien is attuned to a local Court. Apply Mantle as a Social bonus among friends of the Court. Gain a source of Glamour, Mantle benefits, and Contract access as per your Court.

name: Manymask
description: Once a session per dot of Wyrd, spend Glamour to change a feature of your Mask. With Wyrd 5, once per session, spend Glamour to change your Mask almost completely.
descriptionEn: Once a session per dot of Wyrd, spend Glamour to change a feature of your Mask. With Wyrd 5, once per session, spend Glamour to change your Mask almost completely.

name: Market Sense
description: Pay off a Goblin Debt for free once a session through shrewd bargaining.
descriptionEn: Pay off a Goblin Debt for free once a session through shrewd bargaining.

name: Noblesse Oblige
description: Spend Willpower to confer particular bonuses to friends of your Court for a scene.
descriptionEn: Spend Willpower to confer particular bonuses to friends of your Court for a scene.

name: Oath: Blood Liege
description: Swear yourself to a vampire, gain a two dot mentor. Once a lunar month, the vampire may give you a relatively task to be completed in good faith. May cancel this merit to cause a huntsman or true fae to divert their attention to the vampire.
descriptionEn: Swear yourself to a vampire, gain a two dot mentor. Once a lunar month, the vampire may give you a relatively task to be completed in good faith. May cancel this merit to cause a huntsman or true fae to divert their attention to the vampire.

name: Pandemoniacal
description: Apply as bonus dice to incite Bedlam.
descriptionEn: Apply as bonus dice to incite Bedlam.

name: Parallel Lives
description: Share a psychic link with your fetch. You take +2 to read each other's intentions or enter each other's Bastion, or spend Willpower to ride the other's senses or communicate visions telepathically.
descriptionEn: Share a psychic link with your fetch. You take +2 to read each other's intentions or enter each other's Bastion, or spend Willpower to ride the other's senses or communicate visions telepathically.

name: Rigid Mask
description: Mundane humans and devices can't pierce your deceptions, while supernatural beings must force a Clash of Wills to do so. Dropping the Mask causes you lethal damage.
descriptionEn: Mundane humans and devices can't pierce your deceptions, while supernatural beings must force a Clash of Wills to do so. Dropping the Mask causes you lethal damage.

name: Token
description: You have access to one or more Tokens of a total rating equal to dots in this Merit. Multiple characters may share this Merit.
descriptionEn: You have access to one or more Tokens of a total rating equal to dots in this Merit. Multiple characters may share this Merit.

name: Hedgespun Item
description: A permanently active Hedgespun object whose rating is divided among Extraordinary Equipment, Improved Alacrity, and Increased Durability. Each benefit may be selected up to three times.
descriptionEn: A permanently active Hedgespun object whose rating is divided among Extraordinary Equipment, Improved Alacrity, and Increased Durability. Each benefit may be selected up to three times.

name: Touchstone
description: You have an additional Clarity Touchstone for each dot of this Merit.
descriptionEn: You have an additional Clarity Touchstone for each dot of this Merit.

name: Warded Dreams
description: Apply as a bonus to your Bastion's Fortification.
descriptionEn: Apply as a bonus to your Bastion's Fortification.

name: Entitlement
prerequisites: Changeling; the selected title's additional prerequisites
description: A fae title that grants heraldry, duties, a Touchstone, a curse, and ranks equal to Wyrd that may be invested in its heraldry token or blessings.
descriptionEn: A fae title that grants heraldry, duties, a Touchstone, a curse, and ranks equal to Wyrd that may be invested in its heraldry token or blessings.

name: Dramaturge
description: When the changeling fulfills a Contract's Loophole while holding an object with strong dramaturgy appropriate to that Contract, she may either apply one additional Seeming benefit she does not possess or make the invocation reflexive without paying additional Glamour. An ordinary object supports three Common uses or one Royal use before its connection is exhausted. An Icon grants both benefits at once and is then destroyed. The changeling also gains 9-again on rolls to perform a galoshin.
descriptionEn: When the changeling fulfills a Contract's Loophole while holding an object with strong dramaturgy appropriate to that Contract, she may either apply one additional Seeming benefit she does not possess or make the invocation reflexive without paying additional Glamour. An ordinary object supports three Common uses or one Royal use before its connection is exhausted. An Icon grants both benefits at once and is then destroyed. The changeling also gains 9-again on rolls to perform a galoshin.

name: Understudy
description: As an instant action, the changeling dons or brandishes an item dramaturgically representative of another changeling present in the scene, or one whose Icon she possesses. For the scene, whenever either character satisfies a Contract's Loophole, the other does too. When her counterpart invokes a Contract through its Loophole, the dramaturge may copy onto herself any effects that target only the Contract's user. Choosing a new counterpart ends the prior link.
descriptionEn: As an instant action, the changeling dons or brandishes an item dramaturgically representative of another changeling present in the scene, or one whose Icon she possesses. For the scene, whenever either character satisfies a Contract's Loophole, the other does too. When her counterpart invokes a Contract through its Loophole, the dramaturge may copy onto herself any effects that target only the Contract's user. Choosing a new counterpart ends the prior link.

name: Bedside Manner
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Medicine ••
description: After successfully treating another character's wounds and spending at least a scene on additional care, halve that character's healing time for all current lethal and bashing damage.
descriptionEn: After successfully treating another character's wounds and spending at least a scene on additional care, halve that character's healing time for all current lethal and bashing damage.

name: Dressed to Kill
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill ••• or Summer Mantle •• or Summer Court Goodwill ••••; Socialize ••
description: Once per outfit per chapter, take an instant action to turn part of an outfit the character chose into a Durability 2 improvised weapon.
descriptionEn: Once per outfit per chapter, take an instant action to turn part of an outfit the character chose into a Durability 2 improvised weapon.

name: Florence Nightingale Effect
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Empathy •••
description: For one month after caring for someone, double bonuses from Social Merits when interacting with that former patient, and Social actions with them exceptionally succeed on three successes.
descriptionEn: For one month after caring for someone, double bonuses from Social Merits when interacting with that former patient, and Social actions with them exceptionally succeed on three successes.

name: Friends in Low Places
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Barfly
description: Among a particular group of lowlifes, temporarily distribute Merit dots among Status, Allies, and Contacts. These may stack with existing dots but cannot raise a Merit above five; they last for the chapter.
descriptionEn: Among a particular group of lowlifes, temporarily distribute Merit dots among Status, Allies, and Contacts. These may stack with existing dots but cannot raise a Merit above five; they last for the chapter.

name: Spring-Loaded
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Stamina •••
description: Suffer no negative Tilts from consensual intoxication and gain 9-again on Socialize while intoxicated. Rolls to avoid or resist addiction suffer −1.
descriptionEn: Suffer no negative Tilts from consensual intoxication and gain 9-again on Socialize while intoxicated. Rolls to avoid or resist addiction suffer −1.

name: Host with the Most
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••
description: Gain 9-again on actions directly preparing an organized event for at least six people. During the event, apply rote action to three Mental or Social rolls made to keep it running as intended.
descriptionEn: Gain 9-again on actions directly preparing an organized event for at least six people. During the event, apply rote action to three Mental or Social rolls made to keep it running as intended.

name: Meant to Do That
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Presence •••
description: Once per scene, reroll a failed Expression, Persuasion, or Socialize action. On success the original task still fails, but observers interpret the mistake favorably.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, reroll a failed Expression, Persuasion, or Socialize action. On success the original task still fails, but observers interpret the mistake favorably.

name: Look! A Distraction!
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Presence or Manipulation •••
description: Once per chapter after succeeding on an appropriate Social roll, let allies up to the higher of Presence or Manipulation apply those successes to their own Stealth or Subterfuge rolls. The character suffers −3 Stealth for the scene.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter after succeeding on an appropriate Social roll, let allies up to the higher of Presence or Manipulation apply those successes to their own Stealth or Subterfuge rolls. The character suffers −3 Stealth for the scene.

name: No Rest for the Wicked
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Stamina or Resolve •••
description: For days equal to the higher of Stamina or Resolve, regain Willpower through physical or mental activity rather than sleep. The next Clarity attack gains dice for nights without sleep, and Clarity damage cannot heal until the character sleeps.
descriptionEn: For days equal to the higher of Stamina or Resolve, regain Willpower through physical or mental activity rather than sleep. The next Clarity attack gains dice for nights without sleep, and Clarity damage cannot heal until the character sleeps.

name: Street Pharmacist
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Medicine or Streetwise ••
description: Immediately recognize when someone is intoxicated and gain +3 to identify the specific substance.
descriptionEn: Immediately recognize when someone is intoxicated and gain +3 to identify the specific substance.

name: Sucker Born Every Minute
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••; Manipulation •••
description: Gain 9-again on Mental or Social rolls involving hustles, scams, or grifts, whether detecting or conducting them.
descriptionEn: Gain 9-again on Mental or Social rolls involving hustles, scams, or grifts, whether detecting or conducting them.

name: A Taste of Honey
prerequisites: Spring Mantle • or Spring Court Goodwill •••
description: Choose a specific form of desire. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.
descriptionEn: Choose a specific form of desire. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.

name: Beware of Dog
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Retainer •
description: Gain 9-again on Intimidation while accompanied by a frightening animal Retainer. Once per chapter, use it for +2 Defense for turns equal to Retainer dots; the animal gains no defensive benefit.
descriptionEn: Gain 9-again on Intimidation while accompanied by a frightening animal Retainer. Once per chapter, use it for +2 Defense for turns equal to Retainer dots; the animal gains no defensive benefit.

name: Challenge Accepted
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••
description: The first action each scene taken in direct response to a dare or challenge exceptionally succeeds on three successes.
descriptionEn: The first action each scene taken in direct response to a dare or challenge exceptionally succeeds on three successes.

name: Don't Mess with Jim
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Intimidation ••
description: Gain 9-again on Social rolls that leverage the character's violent reputation against someone aware of it, but lose 10-again when trying to make a good impression on such people.
descriptionEn: Gain 9-again on Social rolls that leverage the character's violent reputation against someone aware of it, but lose 10-again when trying to make a good impression on such people.

name: Don't Tell Me to Calm Down
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Composure •• or lower
description: Once per chapter, declare an intention and immediately act on it. Attempts to dissuade the character suffer −2 for the chapter, including attempts by allies.
translatedName: Don't Tell Me to Calm Down
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, declare an intention and immediately act on it. Attempts to dissuade the character suffer −2 for the chapter, including attempts by allies.

name: Firebrand
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Presence •••
description: Open the first Door for free when a Social maneuver argues for one of the character's convictions. With an audience of at least ten, the first action also exceptionally succeeds on three successes.
descriptionEn: Open the first Door for free when a Social maneuver argues for one of the character's convictions. With an audience of at least ten, the first action also exceptionally succeeds on three successes.

name: Get the Manager
prerequisites: Summer Mantle •• or Summer Court Goodwill ••••; Intimidation ••, Summer Mantle ••
description: Against mortals without authority, gain the equivalent of Status •• in the relevant area when making requests that are not blatantly illegal.
descriptionEn: Against mortals without authority, gain the equivalent of Status •• in the relevant area when making requests that are not blatantly illegal.

name: Hey, Watch This
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill ••• or Spring Mantle •• or Spring Court Goodwill ••••; Presence •••
description: Gain +2 Athletics before an audience, increased to +3 when the feat is both risky and unnecessary.
descriptionEn: Gain +2 Athletics before an audience, increased to +3 when the feat is both risky and unnecessary.

name: Locked on Target
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Resolve •••, Stamina •••, Brawl or Weaponry ••
description: A combat Style that turns focused anger into persistence against a chosen opponent.

levels.name: Dialed In
levels.description: Ignore distraction penalties in action scenes up to Summer Mantle.

levels.name: Now I'm Angry
levels.description: After first taking damage in an action scene, gain +1 Brawl or Weaponry attacks against the attacker.

levels.name: Eyes on the Prize
levels.description: Add Merit dots to resist effects that would divert focus from the chosen opponent.

levels.name: You Have Only Made Me Stronger
levels.description: Against an opponent who previously defeated the character, add Summer Mantle to Initiative and to an All-Out Attack, stacking with its usual +2.

levels.name: Payback Time
levels.description: After suffering damage, add the same number of dice to the next attack against its source, up to Resolve times per chapter.

descriptionEn: A combat Style that turns focused anger into persistence against a chosen opponent.

name: Quiet Rage
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Composure •••
description: Once per chapter, substitute Composure for Presence or Strength on an Intimidation action; gain 8-again against people who know the character's quiet reputation. This cannot produce rote action against anyone intimidated this way within the last month.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, substitute Composure for Presence or Strength on an Intimidation action; gain 8-again against people who know the character's quiet reputation. This cannot produce rote action against anyone intimidated this way within the last month.

name: Rageaholic
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Empathy ••
description: Choose a particular form of wrath. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.
descriptionEn: Choose a particular form of wrath. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.

name: Seen Some Shit
prerequisites: Summer Mantle • or Summer Court Goodwill •••; Wyrd •• or Composure ••••
description: Become immune to mundane sources of the Shaken Condition and add half Wyrd, rounded up, to rolls to remain unfazed by horrific or gruesome sights.
descriptionEn: Become immune to mundane sources of the Shaken Condition and add half Wyrd, rounded up, to rolls to remain unfazed by horrific or gruesome sights.

name: Acquired Taste
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Occult ••
description: Choose a sapient supernatural kind that experiences emotion. Gain 9-again when harvesting Glamour from those beings. May be purchased separately for different kinds.
descriptionEn: Choose a sapient supernatural kind that experiences emotion. Gain 9-again when harvesting Glamour from those beings. May be purchased separately for different kinds.

name: Can't Spook a Spooker
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle •• or Autumn Court Goodwill ••••; Autumn Mantle ••
description: Mundane attempts to intimidate or instill fear suffer a penalty equal to Autumn Mantle.
descriptionEn: Mundane attempts to intimidate or instill fear suffer a penalty equal to Autumn Mantle.

name: Favored Phobia
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Intimidation ••
description: Choose a specific fear. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.
descriptionEn: Choose a specific fear. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.

name: Hedgewalker
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Hedge Sense, Wyrd •••
description: Off the path in the Hedge, suffer one self-inflicted lethal damage and spend Willpower to emerge from a portal somewhere in the character's freehold. Wyrd entities gain a cumulative tracking bonus when it is used repeatedly in one story.
descriptionEn: Off the path in the Hedge, suffer one self-inflicted lethal damage and spend Willpower to emerge from a portal somewhere in the character's freehold. Wyrd entities gain a cumulative tracking bonus when it is used repeatedly in one story.

name: I Love a Good Scare
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Cannot have Inured to Terror
description: Regain one spent Willpower upon receiving Frightened, Shaken, Spooked, or another supernatural fear effect.
descriptionEn: Regain one spent Willpower upon receiving Frightened, Shaken, Spooked, or another supernatural fear effect.

name: Improvised Ritual
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Occult •••
description: On a non-Contract Occult ritual, spell, or ceremony, substitute scavenged tools or components without penalty a number of times equal to Merit dots. A failed roll becomes a dramatic failure.
descriptionEn: On a non-Contract Occult ritual, spell, or ceremony, substitute scavenged tools or components without penalty a number of times equal to Merit dots. A failed roll becomes a dramatic failure.

name: Intuitive Artificer
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Occult ••
description: After examining a supernatural object for one minute, reflexively roll Intelligence + Occult. Success reveals its purpose or activation method; exceptional success reveals both.
descriptionEn: After examining a supernatural object for one minute, reflexively roll Intelligence + Occult. Success reveals its purpose or activation method; exceptional success reveals both.

name: Inured to Terror
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••; Cannot have I Love a Good Scare
description: Once per scene, spend Willpower to end Frightened, Shaken, or Spooked without resolving it, or suppress another supernatural fear effect for Composure turns. Suffer −2 to harvest Glamour from fear for 12 hours afterward.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, spend Willpower to end Frightened, Shaken, or Spooked without resolving it, or suppress another supernatural fear effect for Composure turns. Suffer −2 to harvest Glamour from fear for 12 hours afterward.

name: Strange Favor
prerequisites: Autumn Mantle • or Autumn Court Goodwill •••
description: Define a supernatural entity that owes the character a significant favor. After calling it in, lose this Merit and gain the same number of dots in appropriate Merits. The relationship also creates future complications.
descriptionEn: Define a supernatural entity that owes the character a significant favor. After calling it in, lose this Merit and gain the same number of dots in appropriate Merits. The relationship also creates future complications.

name: Grief Connoisseur
prerequisites: Winter Mantle • or Winter Court Goodwill •••; Empathy ••
description: Choose a specific kind of sorrow. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.
descriptionEn: Choose a specific kind of sorrow. Successfully harvesting Glamour from humans experiencing it grants two additional Glamour rather than the usual one for the Court's favored emotion.

name: GTFO
prerequisites: Winter Mantle •• or Winter Court Goodwill ••••; Danger Sense, Wits ••, Stealth ••, Winter Mantle ••
description: A defensive Style for anticipating danger and escaping before capture.

levels.name: Justifiable Paranoia
levels.description: Once per chapter, accept Shaken or Spooked to double Danger Sense until the character next sleeps.

levels.name: Know Your Exits
levels.description: Study the surroundings as an instant action to identify every obvious, unconcealed exit and gain +3 to locate hidden exits.

levels.name: Dead Sprint
levels.description: When Dodging to escape, also move up to twice Speed; while pursued in a Chase, always have the Edge.

levels.name: Not Today, Death!
levels.description: After failing a surprise roll, spend Willpower to retain Defense and act in the first turn, provided the action is used to escape danger.

descriptionEn: A defensive Style for anticipating danger and escaping before capture.

name: Ice-Water Veins
prerequisites: Winter Mantle • or Winter Court Goodwill •••; Composure •••
description: Mundane attempts to manipulate the character's emotions suffer a penalty equal to Composure. Spend Willpower to extend the penalty to supernatural attempts for a scene; the same disconnection impedes emotional harvesting.
descriptionEn: Mundane attempts to manipulate the character's emotions suffer a penalty equal to Composure. Spend Willpower to extend the penalty to supernatural attempts for a scene; the same disconnection impedes emotional harvesting.

name: Misery Loves Company
prerequisites: Winter Mantle • or Winter Court Goodwill •••; Manipulation •••
description: Gain 9-again on Empathy, Socialize, and Subterfuge rolls against someone trying to comfort the character, whether the displayed grief is genuine or not.
descriptionEn: Gain 9-again on Empathy, Socialize, and Subterfuge rolls against someone trying to comfort the character, whether the displayed grief is genuine or not.

name: Shoulder to Cry On
prerequisites: Winter Mantle • or Winter Court Goodwill •••; Empathy ••
description: Gain 8-again on Empathy and Socialize with grieving people. Once per scene, successfully comforting one restores a spent Willpower; a grieving Touchstone instead restores all spent Willpower.
descriptionEn: Gain 8-again on Empathy and Socialize with grieving people. Once per scene, successfully comforting one restores a spent Willpower; a grieving Touchstone instead restores all spent Willpower.

name: Shivers
prerequisites: Winter Mantle •• or Winter Court Goodwill ••••; Winter Mantle ••, Wits •••
description: When directly observed without knowing it, the Storyteller may secretly roll Wits + Composure; success alerts the character even against supernatural or otherworldly observation, but not an unwatched recording device.
descriptionEn: When directly observed without knowing it, the Storyteller may secretly roll Wits + Composure; success alerts the character even against supernatural or otherworldly observation, but not an unwatched recording device.

name: Snow Cover
prerequisites: Winter Mantle •• or Winter Court Goodwill ••••; Winter Mantle ••
description: Spend Willpower to extend the penalty enemies suffer to notice the spying character to Winter Mantle allies within arm's reach. If one member is noticed, the entire group is discovered.
descriptionEn: Spend Willpower to extend the penalty enemies suffer to notice the spying character to Winter Mantle allies within arm's reach. If one member is noticed, the entire group is discovered.

name: Elemental Warrior
prerequisites: Dexterity or Wits •••; Brawl, Firearms, or Weaponry ••; Elemental Weapon or Primal Glory, or Elemental seeming
description: Choose one physical element; every maneuver applies only while commanding or attacking with that element.

levels.name: Wind Cuts to the Bone
levels.description: Pure elemental damage rolls exceptionally succeed on three successes, except Hedgespinning or dreamweaving; a weapon made solely from the element qualifies.

levels.name: Defensive Flurry
levels.description: After doubling Defense to Dodge, add half Wyrd, rounded down, to the pool and permit Dodge against Firearms.

levels.name: Hungry Leaping Flames
levels.description: Spend 1 Glamour for the scene to make melee attacks from 10 yards or meters away and add 10 to every range band of ranged attacks; the element may also disturb scenery.

levels.name: Antaean Endurance
levels.description: While in significant contact with the element, gain half Wyrd Health boxes and the same bonus to resist fatigue, toxins, or unconsciousness.

levels.name: Wrath of Titans
levels.description: Spend 1 Glamour so successful attacks inflict Blinded, Deafened, or Knocked Down for the scene; repeated attacks may affect both eyes or ears.

descriptionEn: Choose one physical element; every maneuver applies only while commanding or attacking with that element.

name: Enchanting Performance
description: A performance Style that channels fae fascination.

levels.name: Limerick
levels.description: Roll Presence + Expression, resisted by Composure, to impose the rolled successes as a penalty, maximum -5, on the target's Social rolls against observers for the scene.

levels.name: Poem
levels.description: After opening a Door through an Expression performance, spend 1 Glamour to open another Door immediately.

levels.name: Sonnet
levels.description: Spend 1 Glamour to give the next mundane performance-related Expression roll rote; success grants one audience member Inspired, while exceptional success grants it to everyone watching.

descriptionEn: A performance Style that channels fae fascination.

name: Hollow
description: A private refuge inside the Hedge. Its rating penalizes attempts to learn an owner's personal information or track them inside, limits forced entry, and buys an equal value of Hollow enhancements. It may be purchased as a Motley Merit.
descriptionEn: A private refuge inside the Hedge. Its rating penalizes attempts to learn an owner's personal information or track them inside, limits forced entry, and buys an equal value of Hollow enhancements. It may be purchased as a Motley Merit.

name: Stable Trod
description: The freehold maintains a trod with a rating equal to this Merit. Up to Stable Trod dots Hollows along it gain the same additional one-dot Hollow enhancement, even above their normal budget. Once per story, roll Stable Trod; each success produces one additional generic goblin fruit containing 1 Glamour.
descriptionEn: The freehold maintains a trod with a rating equal to this Merit. Up to Stable Trod dots Hollows along it gain the same additional one-dot Hollow enhancement, even above their normal budget. Once per story, roll Stable Trod; each success produces one additional generic goblin fruit containing 1 Glamour.

name: Workshop
description: The character maintains specialized tools inside her Hollow. Each dot supplies equipment for one Craft Specialty. Building Equipment or making another Crafts roll with one of those Specialties gains a bonus equal to Workshop dots.
descriptionEn: The character maintains specialized tools inside her Hollow. Each dot supplies equipment for one Craft Specialty. Building Equipment or making another Crafts roll with one of those Specialties gains a bonus equal to Workshop dots.

name: Shared Bastion
description: The character and her motley maintain a permanent shared Bastion. Members wake without finding an exit, its rating penalizes attempts to alter their destiny or minds and to track sleepers within it, and only intruders with greater Wyrd or Supernatural Tolerance may force entry. Its rating also buys an equal value of Bastion features.
descriptionEn: The character and her motley maintain a permanent shared Bastion. Members wake without finding an exit, its rating penalizes attempts to alter their destiny or minds and to track sleepers within it, and only intruders with greater Wyrd or Supernatural Tolerance may force entry. Its rating also buys an equal value of Bastion features.

name: Calming Eidolons
description: Reduce the dreamer's Composure penalty against Subtle Shifts performed by owners of the shared Bastion by this Merit’s dots, to a minimum penalty of one die.
descriptionEn: Reduce the dreamer's Composure penalty against Subtle Shifts performed by owners of the shared Bastion by this Merit’s dots, to a minimum penalty of one die.

name: Motley Awareness
description: At one dot, every motley member gains +1 on Social rolls with the others while anyone owns this Merit. At three dots, the owner senses every motley member's general mood and major changes at any distance and may send private three-word messages; she also suffers the highest Clarity perception penalty in the motley.
descriptionEn: At one dot, every motley member gains +1 on Social rolls with the others while anyone owns this Merit. At three dots, the owner senses every motley member's general mood and major changes at any distance and may send private three-word messages; she also suffers the highest Clarity perception penalty in the motley.

name: Somnambulation
description: An eidolon tends the sleeping character's body while she travels dreams. At three dots it handles basic self-care; at four it performs simple mundane tasks requiring no roll. Going without REM sleep drains Willpower, and at four dots sleeping at 0 Willpower may inflict Comatose on a failed Clarity roll.
descriptionEn: An eidolon tends the sleeping character's body while she travels dreams. At three dots it handles basic self-care; at four it performs simple mundane tasks requiring no roll. Going without REM sleep drains Willpower, and at four dots sleeping at 0 Willpower may inflict Comatose on a failed Clarity roll.

name: Hedge Duelist
source: Changeling the Lost; Book of Seemings addendum
prerequisites: Presence or Manipulation ••, Brawl or Weaponry ••, any Social Skill ••
description: A fae dueling Style whose maneuvers work only in the Hedge. Choose Thousand Falling Leaves or one of the six Seeming-themed alternative first-dot maneuvers. Additional first-dot variants may be purchased as separate instances for one Experience each.

levels.name: Thousand Falling Leaves (Any)
levels.description: Before one attack, inflict −1 Defense on the opponent; a successful attack deals only half its normal damage.

levels.name: Once Bitten, Twice Shy (Beast)
levels.description: After damaging an opponent with an attack this turn, reduce their Initiative on the next turn by the character's Hedge Duelist dots.

levels.name: Shadowplay (Darkling)
levels.description: Gain +2 Defense while in darkness or deep shadow.

levels.name: Treacherous Ground (Elemental)
levels.description: Reduce an opponent's Speed by Hedge Duelist dots while that opponent touches the ground.

levels.name: Unblemished Poise (Fairest)
levels.description: While no damage is marked on the character's Health track, add Hedge Duelist dots to Initiative.

levels.name: The Crashing Oak (Ogre)
levels.description: Gain +3 from an All-Out Attack instead of +2.

levels.name: Spite is Strength (Wizened)
levels.description: Gain +1 to attack rolls this turn if the opponent damaged the character during the previous turn.

levels.name: Emerald Shield
levels.description: Gain Armor 2/0 in the Hedge. It stacks with worn armor, but not armor granted by Hedgespinning or Contracts.

levels.name: Bite Like Thorns
levels.description: Add dice to attacks equal to the wound penalty currently suffered by the opponent.

levels.name: Whispers Beyond the Path
levels.description: Instead of a physical attack, roll Presence + Intimidation or Manipulation + Subterfuge, contested by Resolve + Composure. On success, roll the difference in successes and inflict that much minor Clarity damage; the character also suffers one minor Clarity damage.

levels.name: Symphony of Thorns
levels.description: During a Hedge Duel, attack rolls suffer no penalty for generating shaping successes through Hedgespinning.

descriptionEn: A fae dueling Style whose maneuvers work only in the Hedge. Choose Thousand Falling Leaves or one of the six Seeming-themed alternative first-dot maneuvers. Additional first-dot variants may be purchased as separate instances for one Experience each.

name: Blood and Bone
description: Choose two Skills, at least one Physical; both gain 9-again. Gain +2 to empathize or relate to the animal reflected by the fae mien. Strengthening the Mask costs 1 Willpower the first time each chapter.
descriptionEn: Choose two Skills, at least one Physical; both gain 9-again. Gain +2 to empathize or relate to the animal reflected by the fae mien. Strengthening the Mask costs 1 Willpower the first time each chapter.

name: Debaucher
description: Gain a Vice and fulfill it as a mortal does. After regaining Willpower from it once in a chapter, each further fulfillment causes one die of minor Clarity damage.
descriptionEn: Gain a Vice and fulfill it as a mortal does. After regaining Willpower from it once in a chapter, each further fulfillment causes one die of minor Clarity damage.

name: Fae Pet
description: A Retainer animal gains one Dread Power, portaling powered by Willpower, and a Mask and fae mien. It may scour but not strengthen its Mask and cannot be killed for plot purposes without permission.
descriptionEn: A Retainer animal gains one Dread Power, portaling powered by Willpower, and a Mask and fae mien. It may scour but not strengthen its Mask and cannot be killed for plot purposes without permission.

name: Green Grocer
description: Maintain two additional goblin fruits outside the Hedge per Merit dot.
descriptionEn: Maintain two additional goblin fruits outside the Hedge per Merit dot.

name: Hot Pursuit
description: Once per scene, while within Speed meters of a quarry, spend 1 Glamour to move within arm's reach and gain the Edge in a chase.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, while within Speed meters of a quarry, spend 1 Glamour to move within arm's reach and gain the Edge in a chase.

name: Just Try Me
description: Once per scene, after a verbal assault or insult, reflexively spend 1 Glamour to inflict Shaken; this cannot counter supernatural powers. Lose 10-again on Socialize with people who know the character only by reputation.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, after a verbal assault or insult, reflexively spend 1 Glamour to inflict Shaken; this cannot counter supernatural powers. Lose 10-again on Socialize with people who know the character only by reputation.

name: Mad, Bad, and Dangerous
description: When Striking Looks benefits a first impression, three successes count as exceptional.
descriptionEn: When Striking Looks benefits a first impression, three successes count as exceptional.

name: Malignant Mien
description: Once per scene, spend 1 Glamour so the next successful attack with natural weapons from the Beast blessing or Lethal Mien deals aggravated damage. Related Clarity damage rolls gain 9-again.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, spend 1 Glamour so the next successful attack with natural weapons from the Beast blessing or Lethal Mien deals aggravated damage. Related Clarity damage rolls gain 9-again.

name: Running with the Wolves
description: Gain a particular animal group as Allies •••. Spend 1 Glamour to send them a short telepathic message within Wyrd × 2 kilometers; Wits + Animal Ken may be needed to understand complex replies.
descriptionEn: Gain a particular animal group as Allies •••. Spend 1 Glamour to send them a short telepathic message within Wyrd × 2 kilometers; Wits + Animal Ken may be needed to understand complex replies.

name: Screw It
description: Once per Social maneuver, regain 1 Willpower after a failed roll, but not a dramatic failure.
descriptionEn: Once per Social maneuver, regain 1 Willpower after a failed roll, but not a dramatic failure.

name: Total Abandon
description: When making a Brawl All-Out Attack, spend 1 Glamour to add the Merit dots as weapon damage; Defense suffers an additional -2 on the next turn.
descriptionEn: When making a Brawl All-Out Attack, spend 1 Glamour to add the Merit dots as weapon damage; Defense suffers an additional -2 on the next turn.

name: From the Shadows
description: After rolling a surprise attack, spend 1 Glamour to give the action 8-again.
descriptionEn: After rolling a surprise attack, spend 1 Glamour to give the action 8-again.

name: Hidden Life
description: Anonymity dots penalize supernatural attempts to locate the character, and concealment actions gain 9-again. The fifth dot of any Status, including Mantle and Court Goodwill, costs 1 additional Experience.
descriptionEn: Anonymity dots penalize supernatural attempts to locate the character, and concealment actions gain 9-again. The fifth dot of any Status, including Mantle and Court Goodwill, costs 1 additional Experience.

name: Look Over There!
description: Spend 1 additional Glamour when portaling to create a distraction and gain one turn to flee unnoticed, provided the character only runs and does not invade another's immediate space.
descriptionEn: Spend 1 additional Glamour when portaling to create a distraction and gain one turn to flee unnoticed, provided the character only runs and does not invade another's immediate space.

name: Lucidity in Lunacy
description: When more than half the Clarity boxes are damaged, roll Wyrd + current Clarity damage. On success, the Storyteller reveals a concealed truth in a strange, indirect form.
descriptionEn: When more than half the Clarity boxes are damaged, roll Wyrd + current Clarity damage. On success, the Storyteller reveals a concealed truth in a strange, indirect form.

name: Mirror Me
description: Once per chapter at Storyteller discretion, an unobserved reflection can move or pickpocket a reflected Size 1 or smaller object and place it on the character. The reflection may act selfishly.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter at Storyteller discretion, an unobserved reflection can move or pickpocket a reflected Size 1 or smaller object and place it on the character. The reflection may act selfishly.

name: Perfect Stillness
description: While perfectly still, attempts to find the character suffer -3, increased to -5 for searchers associated with the former Keeper.
descriptionEn: While perfectly still, attempts to find the character suffer -3, increased to -5 for searchers associated with the former Keeper.

name: Poor Little Paranoid
description: Track all unconcealed people and objects already perceived without an action and notice any scene change. Danger Sense becomes +3. Suffer -2 to Socialize and Expression with unfamiliar humans unless Willpower suppresses this Merit for the scene.
descriptionEn: Track all unconcealed people and objects already perceived without an action and notice any scene change. Danger Sense becomes +3. Suffer -2 to Socialize and Expression with unfamiliar humans unless Willpower suppresses this Merit for the scene.

name: Puzzler
description: Gain 8-again on instant or extended Academics or Investigation actions to solve an intended puzzle.
descriptionEn: Gain 8-again on instant or extended Academics or Investigation actions to solve an intended puzzle.

name: Riddle Me This
description: An exceptional Expression or Subterfuge success used to baffle someone with wordplay inflicts Confused.
descriptionEn: An exceptional Expression or Subterfuge success used to baffle someone with wordplay inflicts Confused.

name: Secret Seer
description: Once per day on first meeting someone, roll Wits + Wyrd; success reveals two truths and a lie. Failure inflicts Paranoid, and each person can trigger the attempt only once.
descriptionEn: Once per day on first meeting someone, roll Wits + Wyrd; success reveals two truths and a lie. Failure inflicts Paranoid, and each person can trigger the attempt only once.

name: Wrapped in an Enigma
description: Once per chapter, add half Wyrd, rounded up, as bonus dice or successes to Subterfuge concerning facts about the character.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, add half Wyrd, rounded up, as bonus dice or successes to Subterfuge concerning facts about the character.

name: Conjuror's Call
description: Spend 1 Willpower to create a small, task-sized amount of the character's associated element from nothing.
descriptionEn: Spend 1 Willpower to create a small, task-sized amount of the character's associated element from nothing.

name: Foiled Forensics
description: Biological traces left behind revert to the associated element after half of (10 - Wyrd) hours, rounded up; clothing and damage evidence remain.
descriptionEn: Biological traces left behind revert to the associated element after half of (10 - Wyrd) hours, rounded up; clothing and damage evidence remain.

name: Resting Birch Face
description: Before the character speaks in a scene, another's first Social action against him is penalized by his Presence. Friendly or gentle approaches suffer -1 unless enhanced with Willpower.
descriptionEn: Before the character speaks in a scene, another's first Social action against him is penalized by his Presence. Friendly or gentle approaches suffer -1 unless enhanced with Willpower.

name: Smelling Like a Rose
description: Social rolls aided by the pleasant scent of the associated element exceptionally succeed on three successes, but the scent may make the character memorable.
descriptionEn: Social rolls aided by the pleasant scent of the associated element exceptionally succeed on three successes, but the scent may make the character memorable.

name: Stomach of Steel
description: The character can digest any safely swallowed substance and never suffers hunger or thirst while able to fill his stomach.
descriptionEn: The character can digest any safely swallowed substance and never suffers hunger or thirst while able to fill his stomach.

name: Unbroken Branches
description: A recovered severed limb or body part can be reattached without loss of function and heals normally.
descriptionEn: A recovered severed limb or body part can be reattached without loss of function and heals normally.

name: Stone-Hearted
description: Willpower spent to resist Mental or Social influence adds +3 rather than +2, and the character has one additional Door in Social maneuvering.
descriptionEn: Willpower spent to resist Mental or Social influence adds +3 rather than +2, and the character has one additional Door in Social maneuvering.

name: Eerie Eyes
description: Define an unusual sensory organ; unless it is covered or attacked, physical obstruction cannot blind the character.
descriptionEn: Define an unusual sensory organ; unless it is covered or attacked, physical obstruction cannot blind the character.

name: Still Waters Run Deep
description: Choose an Attribute. Surrounded by the associated element, treat it as one dot higher, gain 9-again on its rolls, and ignore the element's Environmental Tilt. More than a day without contact inflicts Deprived until one hour of immersion.
descriptionEn: Choose an Attribute. Surrounded by the associated element, treat it as one dot higher, gain 9-again on its rolls, and ignore the element's Environmental Tilt. More than a day without contact inflicts Deprived until one hour of immersion.

name: Fire-Forged Friends
prerequisites: Elemental or Occult •••; Empathy ••; Contract of Primal Glory
description: Primal Glory may be bestowed on up to Wyrd allies per scene by touch and an instant action each; spending 1 Glamour also shares accessible Seeming-specific blessings.
alternativePrerequisites: Occult •••; Empathy ••; Contract of Primal Glory
descriptionEn: Primal Glory may be bestowed on up to Wyrd allies per scene by touch and an instant action each; spending 1 Glamour also shares accessible Seeming-specific blessings.

name: Confessional Countenance
description: Gain +2 on Social rolls with someone revealing sensitive information, or +3 if they have Embarrassing Secret; strangers may volunteer useful information without a roll.
descriptionEn: Gain +2 on Social rolls with someone revealing sensitive information, or +3 if they have Embarrassing Secret; strangers may volunteer useful information without a roll.

name: Just Your Type
description: While using Barfly, count as having Striking Looks ••; if already possessed, double its bonuses.
descriptionEn: While using Barfly, count as having Striking Looks ••; if already possessed, double its bonuses.

name: Mover and Shaker
description: Choose a mortal subculture. Spend 1 Glamour to add Merit dots to Social actions with its members and exceptionally succeed on three successes; once per story, also use the dots as Allies.
descriptionEn: Choose a mortal subculture. Spend 1 Glamour to add Merit dots to Social actions with its members and exceptionally succeed on three successes; once per story, also use the dots as Allies.

name: Multimask
description: Manymask changes two features per Glamour, and can change the entire appearance at Wyrd 3 rather than 5.
descriptionEn: Manymask changes two features per Glamour, and can change the entire appearance at Wyrd 3 rather than 5.

name: Not Just a Pretty Face
description: Gain +2 on Social rolls when playing into an attractive stereotype to be underestimated; lose 10-again when trying to appear competent to those who have not witnessed that competence.
descriptionEn: Gain +2 on Social rolls when playing into an attractive stereotype to be underestimated; lose 10-again when trying to appear competent to those who have not witnessed that competence.

name: Power Behind the Throne
description: For a scene, grant an ally temporary dots in one of the character's Social Skills up to the Merit rating and owned Skill rating. The character suffers an equal penalty if using that Skill in the same scene.
descriptionEn: For a scene, grant an ally temporary dots in one of the character's Social Skills up to the Merit rating and owned Skill rating. The character suffers an equal penalty if using that Skill in the same scene.

name: Sanguine Sacrifice
description: Self-inflict lethal damage and anoint another changeling with the blood to restore 2 Glamour per damage. Mitigation cannot reduce the sacrifice, and healing it in the same scene removes the Glamour.
descriptionEn: Self-inflict lethal damage and anoint another changeling with the blood to restore 2 Glamour per damage. Mitigation cannot reduce the sacrifice, and healing it in the same scene removes the Glamour.

name: Soothing Presence
description: While present, reduce a Clarity attack against a Motley Oathmate by one die; afterward, Clarity attacks against the character gain +1 for the scene.
descriptionEn: While present, reduce a Clarity attack against a Motley Oathmate by one die; afterward, Clarity attacks against the character gain +1 for the scene.

name: Cast-Iron Stomach
description: Consume spoiled, raw, or otherwise unsafe food without harm and add Wyrd to resist ingested toxins and diseases.
descriptionEn: Consume spoiled, raw, or otherwise unsafe food without harm and add Wyrd to resist ingested toxins and diseases.

name: I Smell the Blood of an Englishman
description: Automatically detect blood within Wyrd × 10 meters. After tasting a creature's blood, add Wyrd to track it and to detect hidden people or details through blood traces.
translatedName: I Smell the Blood of an Englishman
descriptionEn: Automatically detect blood within Wyrd × 10 meters. After tasting a creature's blood, add Wyrd to track it and to detect hidden people or details through blood traces.

name: Large and in Charge
description: Once per scene on a Social action to command attention or direct others, substitute Size for Presence; if Presence is not lower, gain rote instead.
descriptionEn: Once per scene on a Social action to command attention or direct others, substitute Size for Presence; if Presence is not lower, gain rote instead.

name: Living Large
description: Once per chapter, acquire goods through intimidation or petty crime instead of Resources, up to Availability equal to half Size, rounded up; consequences still apply.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, acquire goods through intimidation or petty crime instead of Resources, up to Availability equal to half Size, rounded up; consequences still apply.

name: Looming Large
description: Gain +2 to Intimidation-based rolls against smaller characters.
descriptionEn: Gain +2 to Intimidation-based rolls against smaller characters.

name: Meat Shield
description: A progressive protection style.

levels.name: Think Twice
levels.description: Add Intimidation to Initiative in the first turn of a violent encounter.

levels.name: Get Behind Me
levels.description: Provide substantial ranged concealment to characters behind you, or total concealment if they are smaller.

levels.name: Remember Me?
levels.description: Once per turn, contest Presence + Intimidation against an attacker targeting a nearby ally; on success they attack you instead, against half Defense.

levels.name: I Can Take It
levels.description: Spend 1 Willpower when Remember Me? redirects a successful attack to halve its damage, rounded down, minimum 1.

levels.name: Buy Time
levels.description: When one of the last three Health boxes is filled and an ally is threatened, spend 1 Willpower and an instant action to gain Stamina armor until the next turn.

descriptionEn: A progressive protection style.

name: Thick-Headed
description: Successful physical attacks against the head deal one less damage; successful attacks made with the head deal +1 damage.
descriptionEn: Successful physical attacks against the head deal one less damage; successful attacks made with the head deal +1 damage.

name: Thick-Skinned
description: Ignore a physical attack or hazard that would inflict exactly one bashing damage.
descriptionEn: Ignore a physical attack or hazard that would inflict exactly one bashing damage.

name: Tickets to the Gun Show
description: When visibly displaying physical prowess to distract or attract, Social actions gain 8-again. Each use after the first in a scene takes a cumulative -1.
descriptionEn: When visibly displaying physical prowess to distract or attract, Social actions gain 8-again. Each use after the first in a scene takes a cumulative -1.

name: Too Simple to Fool
description: Gain +2 to resist verbal trickery. If Intelligence permanently rises above 1, the Merit is lost under Sanctity of Merits.
descriptionEn: Gain +2 to resist verbal trickery. If Intelligence permanently rises above 1, the Merit is lost under Sanctity of Merits.

name: Gnarled
description: The character has no natural lifespan. Taking one extra interval on an extended action grants 9-again, while remaining limited by the dice pool; physical aging continues to apparent late sixties.
descriptionEn: The character has no natural lifespan. Taking one extra interval on an extended action grants 9-again, while remaining limited by the dice pool; physical aging continues to apparent late sixties.

name: Iron Toes
description: Gain Armor 1 against self-inflicted physical damage caused by mistakes or mishaps.
descriptionEn: Gain Armor 1 against self-inflicted physical damage caused by mistakes or mishaps.

name: Know-It-All
description: Choose Academics, Occult, Politics, or Science. Rolls with it gain 9-again, and Willpower adds +4 instead of +3.
descriptionEn: Choose Academics, Occult, Politics, or Science. Rolls with it gain 9-again, and Willpower adds +4 instead of +3.

name: Material Affinity
description: Choose a specific material at one dot or a broad category at three. Non-Crafts actions substantially involving it exceptionally succeed on three successes; Crafts and Expression directly working it gain Advanced Action. Iron is forbidden and an upgrade must retain the same category.
descriptionEn: Choose a specific material at one dot or a broad category at three. Non-Crafts actions substantially involving it exceptionally succeed on three successes; Crafts and Expression directly working it gain Advanced Action. Iron is forbidden and an upgrade must retain the same category.

name: Percussive Maintenance
description: Instead of a Crafts roll for a simple repair, deal 1 Structure damage as an instant action to make the device function for the scene. Each use adds one required success to a permanent repair.
descriptionEn: Instead of a Crafts roll for a simple repair, deal 1 Structure damage as an instant action to make the device function for the scene. Each use adds one required success to a permanent repair.

name: Perfectionist
prerequisites: Wizened; Wits ••; Crafts, Expression, or Occult •••
description: After a successful Build Equipment action, spend 1 Glamour and up to 3 Willpower; each Willpower adds one to Durability, Structure, or Equipment bonus, each at most once and never above +5. Teamwork requires every participant to possess this Merit.
descriptionEn: After a successful Build Equipment action, spend 1 Glamour and up to 3 Willpower; each Willpower adds one to Durability, Structure, or Equipment bonus, each at most once and never above +5. Teamwork requires every participant to possess this Merit.

name: Pinchpenny
description: Gain rote on rolls to negotiate prices or exchanges of service.
descriptionEn: Gain rote on rolls to negotiate prices or exchanges of service.

name: Razor Tongue
description: An exceptional Social success to belittle, mock, or humiliate causes the subject to lose 1 Willpower.
descriptionEn: An exceptional Social success to belittle, mock, or humiliate causes the subject to lose 1 Willpower.

name: Spiteful Competence
description: Once per scene, Willpower adds +5 instead of +3 when retrying an action previously failed publicly before witnesses.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, Willpower adds +5 instead of +3 when retrying an action previously failed publicly before witnesses.

name: Tinkerer
description: Ignore penalties to Crafts for improvised tools.
descriptionEn: Ignore penalties to Crafts for improvised tools.

name: Token Crucible
description: A dedicated Hollow facility reduces Hedge-forged token creation by one chapter, minimum one, and remains protected by the Hollow. It consumes a new load of exotic fuel each operating chapter.
descriptionEn: A dedicated Hollow facility reduces Hedge-forged token creation by one chapter, minimum one, and remains protected by the Hollow. It consumes a new load of exotic fuel each operating chapter.

name: Told You So
description: Once per scene, regain 1 Willpower when the character or a present ally dramatically fails an action whose chances the character previously disparaged.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, regain 1 Willpower when the character or a present ally dramatically fails an action whose chances the character previously disparaged.
